messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a schema rollforward on users.accounts to add preferred_language VARCHAR(8) NULL. Target change window 23:00-23:30 UTC tonight. Plan: snapshot -> apply DDL with a brief exclusive lock (~10s) -> async batched backfill. Will pin services to v2.17.3 for the apply. Feature flag: user-lang.

maria: Quick checklist:
- create consistent snapshot (pg_dump?) of accounts before apply
- apply DDL on primary (expect ~10s table lock)
- start backfill workers with batch_size=500, rate_limit=200 rps
- monitor replication lag and error queue

maria: Deploy command I'll run (deploybot):
```
/deploy migrate --job=pref-lang-20260320 --tag=2026-03-20-pref-lang \ 
  --quiesce 23:00-23:05 --pin-version=2.17.3
```

tom: OK. Who's taking canary? I can watch the first 5 minutes and validate API responses for language fallback.

priya: A couple Qs:
- Is the column nullable? (yes -> no immediate writes needed)
- Any materialized views that reference users.accounts? Need to regen?

maria: Column is nullable. No MV touches expected; I grepped the repo and only auth-service reads accounts.*email/name — confirmed. Will add a quick migration step to publish schema change to discovery service.

eli: Suggest adding a safety abort in the backfill: if error rate > 2% for 5m or processed rows > 5M in 10m, pause and notify. We should also sample 100 rows post-backfill for output sanity.

maria: Good call. I'll add the guard and an automated pause hook that requires manual resume. Pseudocode:
```
if (errors/total > 0.02 for 5m) then pause_backfill() and post#eng-releases @tom @priya
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled: pref-lang-20260320 by maria. Window: 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z - 2026-03-20T23:30:00Z. Quiesce period: 23:00-23:05. Pin: 2.17.3.

priya: Read path compatibility: recommend warming caches for auth-service around 22:50 UTC to avoid thundering on first post-change reads. Also will bring a read-replica out of promoting pool for a quick check.

tom: Rollback plan? If DDL apply fails or causes long lock, what's the escape?

maria: Rollback options:
- If DDL apply fails early (before commit) -> abort, no state change.
- If apply applies but downstream errors spike -> we can revert service pin to 2.17.2 (old behavior) and run revert migration (DROP COLUMN if unused).
- If backfill causes load, backfill can be paused and resumed; we won't drop data automatically.

eli: Also add a short-run feature flag fallback: featureflag=user-lang=false will keep new code paths disabled so old code won't touch the new column. That reduces blast radius.

maria: Added that. Release notes snippet: "Add nullable column preferred_language to users.accounts. Backfill runs async; opt-out via featureflag=user-lang. Services pinned to v2.17.3 during window." I'll put this in the release notes doc.

sre-bot: Monitoring endpoints: 
- infra: https://grafana.redwood/boards/db/migrations?pref-lang
- errors: https://sentry.redwood/organizations/redwood/issues/?query=pref-lang
- replication lag: https://pgmon/replication

tom: tagging: @oncall tonight is eli, ping him on first sign of >5s p99 latency. I'll handle canary smoke tests: create account, fetch profile, ensure no 500s and preferred_language returns null by default.

priya: I'll warm caches and verify discovery service publishes schema change. Also will watch materialized view rebuilds.

maria: I'll kick off the snapshot at 22:45, start the deploybot command at 23:00, run the DDL at 23:02 (expected 10s lock), and then start backfill at 23:06. Will post progress updates here every 5m.

tom: :thumbsup:

eli: Oncall ack. Will watch SLOs and replication. If anything looks off I'll call rollback.

maria: Final: holding deploy until all signoffs. Please reply with OK when you can watch during the window.

tom: OK
priya: OK
eli: OK

maria: Thanks — starting snapshot prep in 45m. I will post the exact deploybot run id here once the job is scheduled.
